title: Batalin-Vilkovisky description of Yang-Mills theories with universal extra dimensions
summary: The Batalin-Vilkovisky (BV) framework is a powerful technique for quantizing a wide range of gauge systems. This formalism employs fields and antifields--introducing a symplectic structure through the antibracket--to implement BRST symmetry, which captures the essence of gauge invariance. Within this context, we study the symmetry structure of a pure Yang-Mills theory with universal extra dimensions.
